## Step 1

The $m$-th moment is the expectation of

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
\left(a\alpha-b\beta\right)^{m} & = & \sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}a^{k}b^{m-k}\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}
\end{eqnarray*}$$ where

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
a & = & W_{0}e^{\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t}=W_{0}e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)T}\\
b & = & e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)T}\\
\end{eqnarray*}$$

So the $m$-th moment is the expectation of

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
\left(a\alpha-b\beta\right)^{m} & = & \sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}W_{0}^ke^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)kT}e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)(m-k)T}\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\\
 & = & \sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}W_{0}^ke^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)mT}\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\\
 & = & e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)mT}\sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}W_{0}^k \alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}
\end{eqnarray*}$$

and so the $m$-th moment is

$$\mathbb{E}\left[e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)mT}\sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}W_{0}^k \alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\right]=e^{\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)mT}\sum_{k=0}^{m}\left(-1\right)^{m-k}{m \choose k}W_{0}^k \mathbb{E}\left[\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\right]$$ {#eq-m-moment}

## Step 2

We need to compute $\mathbb{E}\left[\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\right]$, where

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
\alpha & = & e^{\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\phi_{i}}=e^{\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}S_{0}}\\
 \beta & = & \sum_{i=0}^{n}c_{i}e^{-\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)i\Delta t+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}S_{i}}
\end{eqnarray*}$$

and so before computing $\mathbb{E}\left[\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}\right]$, note that $\alpha^{k}\beta^{m-k}$ is

$$\begin{align*}
e^{\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}kS_{0}}\prod^{m}_{i=k+1}\beta & =e^{\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}kS_{0}}\sum^{n}_{\kappa_{k+1}=0}\cdots\sum^{n}_{\kappa_{m}=0}\left(\prod^{m}_{\ell=k+1}c_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)\exp\left\{ -\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}\kappa_{\ell}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}S_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right\} \\
 & =\sum^{n}_{\kappa_{k+1}=0}\cdots\sum^{n}_{\kappa_{m}=0}\left(\prod^{m}_{\ell=k+1}c_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)\exp\left\{ -\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}\kappa_{\ell}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(kS_{0}+\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}S_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)\right\} 
\end{align*}$$

::: callout-note
For reference: $m$ is the moment number and the upper index in the choose expression, $k$ is the lower index in the choose expression (i.e. ${m \choose k}$) in [-@eq-m-moment], and $S_i\equiv\sum_{r=i}^{n-1}\phi_r$, where the $\phi_r$ are IID Gaussian random variables. The variable $n$ is the number of time steps in the process with step increment $\Delta t$, and $n\Delta t = T$.
:::

## Step 3

Note that the summand is symmetric

$$ 
\varphi\left(j_{k+1},\ldots,j_{m}\right)=\left(\prod^{m}_{\ell=k+1}c_{j_{\ell}}\right)\exp\left\{ -\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}j_{\ell}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(kS_{0}+\sum^{m}_{\ell=k+1}S_{j_{\ell}}\right)\right\} $$

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
\varphi\left(\kappa_{k+1},\ldots,\kappa_{m}\right) & \equiv & \left(\prod_{\ell=k+1}^{m}c_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)e^{-\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum_{\ell=k+1}^{m}\kappa_{\ell}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(kS_{0}+\sum_{\ell=k+1}^{m}S_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)}\\
 & = & \left(\prod_{\ell=k+1}^{m}c_{\kappa_{\ell}}\right)e^{-\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum_{\ell=k+1}^{m}\kappa_{\ell}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(k\left(S_{0}-S_{\kappa_{k+1}}\right)+\sum_{\ell=k+1}^{m}\ell\left(S_{\kappa_{\ell}}-S_{\kappa_{\ell+1}}\right)\right)}
\end{eqnarray*}$$

ok

$$\begin{eqnarray*}
\varphi\left(\kappa_{k+1},\ldots,\kappa_{m}\right) & \equiv & \left(\prod_{i=k+1}^{m}c_{\kappa_{i}}\right)e^{-\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum_{i=k+1}^{m}\kappa_{i}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(kS_{0}+\sum_{i=k+1}^{m}S_{\kappa_{i}}\right)}\\
 & = & \left(\prod_{i=k+1}^{m}c_{\kappa_{i}}\right)e^{-\left(\mu-\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right)\Delta t\sum_{i=k+1}^{m}\kappa_{i}+\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\left(k\left(S_{0}-S_{\kappa_{k+1}}\right)+\sum_{i=k+1}^{m}i\left(S_{\kappa_{i}}-S_{\kappa_{i+1}}\right)\right)}
\end{eqnarray*}$$

## Step 4
